Package corewar.redcode

Class Instruction

java.lang.Object
corewar.redcode.Instruction
public class Instruction extends Object
Represents a single Redcode instruction in the Core War simulation. An instruction consists of an Opcode and two operands (A and B), each with its own addressing mode and integer value.
